build_navit_model: build a NaViT Vision Transformer model with variable-size image support, token dropout, and attention pooling
group_images_by_max_seq_len: group a list of image tensors by maximum sequence length for efficient batching with variable resolutions
create_attention_module: create a self-attention module with RMSNorm query-key normalization and scaled dot-product attention
create_transformer_encoder: create a transformer encoder stack with alternating attention and feedforward layers using LayerNorm
test_token_dropout: test variable token dropout rates computed from image height and width before transformer processing
